external_motivation: docs/design/2026-06-02-co-scientist-222-l3-transfer-matrix.md identifies sub-assumption x evidence decomposition as a genuine, previously-unbuilt extension to source_verification_agent's Source Quality Matrix, adapted from the Co-Scientist paper's deep verification review (Gottweis et al. 2026, Methods, Reflection agent). This set measures whether the implemented Claim Decomposition pass reports rather than rules, fires only on an explicit premise-check request for one claim, and stays off in fact-check mode.
purpose: Measure whether the Claim Decomposition pass (deep-research/agents/source_verification_agent.md Section 4) states that a claim fails when a needed premise is CONTRADICTED, states that a claim is not established (distinct from refuted) when a needed premise is UNSUPPORTED, reports a CONTRADICTED premise before an UNSUPPORTED one when both occur, flags but does not reject the claim when a premise it does not need is weak, reports that every premise HOLDS separately from the 2+-independent-source cross-check that actually decides the claim, states when fewer than two independent sources are available for that cross-check, and produces no Claim Decomposition block at all when the user names no claim or is using fact-check mode on a list of claims.

scoring.pass_rule: An item passes iff the subject's per-premise verdicts and Reading match ground_truth.expected_premise_verdicts and ground_truth.expected_reading; when ground_truth.expected_cross_check is present, the subject's Cross-check line must also match it; and the output exhibits none of the fail_patterns. cd-04 passes iff the subject's output contains no Claim Decomposition section at all. cd-06 passes iff the subject's fact-check output is unchanged (each listed claim gets its own verdict) with no Claim Decomposition block for any of them.
scoring.adjudication: maintainer, pre-registered per evals/heldout/MEASUREMENT_CONTRACT.md; a run must file a heldout-measurement/1.1 report before any pass-rate is quoted
scoring.reported_measure: pass count per scenario_type; no aggregate quality-improvement claim

generator: maintainer-authored synthetic items (fictional programs, authors, trials); no real study is described

items.user_claim: The Kestrel School District's 2023 sodium-reduction program lowered adolescent blood pressure within one semester, because the reformulated meals cut average sodium intake by 30%.

verified_source_set.summary: Kestrel School District (2023) program evaluation: reformulated school lunches measured a 9% reduction in students' average sodium intake over one semester; average systolic blood pressure showed no significant change at one semester (p = 0.41).

expected_premise_verdicts.premise: the reformulation cut average sodium intake by 30%
expected_premise_verdicts.basis: kestrel2023 reports the measured reduction as 9%, not 30%

ground_truth.expected_reading: The needed premise is contradicted by the cited source's own reported figure, so the claim fails as stated.
fail_patterns: hedging the magnitude ('intake fell substantially') without stating the contradiction
citing kestrel2023 as support for the 30% figure
classifying the premise as UNSUPPORTED instead of CONTRADICTED when the source states the actual, lower figure

items.user_claim: The TaleBridge after-school reading program raised third-grade reading fluency because it recruited reading specialists with an average of ten years' classroom experience.

verified_source_set.summary: TaleBridge program trial: reports a fluency gain of +12 words correct per minute (WCPM) after one school year, staffed by "credentialed reading specialists." Gives no data on specialists' years of classroom experience.

expected_premise_verdicts.premise: the program's reading specialists averaged ten years' classroom experience
expected_premise_verdicts.basis: talebridge2022 states the specialists are credentialed but gives no figure for years of experience

ground_truth.expected_reading: The stated causal mechanism (ten years' average experience) has no support, so the claim as framed is not established, distinct from being refuted; the fluency gain itself is a separate, supported finding.
fail_patterns: classifying the premise as CONTRADICTED ('the source shows this is false') rather than UNSUPPORTED
treating "credentialed" as evidence for "ten years' experience"
dropping the premise table and reporting the claim as fully established because the fluency gain is real

items.user_claim: Community garden participation improved self-reported diet quality among the Brambleton pilot's adult participants over one growing season, and most participants were recruited through senior-center mailing lists.

verified_source_set.summary: Brambleton pilot (2021), n = 64 adult participants: diet-quality index rose significantly pre/post one growing season (p < .01). Recruitment is described only as "community outreach"; no recruitment channel is named.

expected_premise_verdicts.premise: most participants were recruited through senior-center mailing lists
expected_premise_verdicts.basis: brambleton2021 does not name a recruitment channel at all

ground_truth.expected_reading: The diet-quality finding stands on its own supported basis; the recruitment detail is flagged as an unsupported aside that does not affect it.
fail_patterns: rejecting or [MATERIAL GAP]-marking the whole claim because a premise the claim does not need is unsupported
silently dropping the weak premise with no mention in the table
treating the recruitment detail as needed to establish the diet-quality improvement

items.user_claim: The Driftwood Clinic telehealth follow-up program cut 30-day hospital readmissions among its heart-failure patients by about one third, through twice-weekly symptom check-ins run by on-call nurses.

verified_source_set.summary: Driftwood Clinic telehealth pilot (2021), Results section 3.1: 30-day readmission rate among enrolled heart-failure patients fell from 24% to 16% over the pilot year (a one-third relative reduction). Methods section 2.3 names twice-weekly nurse-led symptom check-ins as the program’s core component.

Regional Health Network multi-site evaluation (2022), p. 14: the Driftwood-affiliated site’s telehealth follow-up reduced 30-day heart-failure readmissions by approximately one third relative to the network’s historical baseline, under a twice-weekly check-in protocol consistent with the site’s program description.

expected_premise_verdicts.premise: readmissions fell by about one third
expected_premise_verdicts.basis: driftwood_pilot_2021 section 3.1 and regional_health_network_2022 p. 14 independently report approximately a one-third reduction
driftwood_pilot_2021 section 2.3 states the check-ins are twice-weekly; regional_health_network_2022 p. 14 corroborates the same protocol

ground_truth.expected_reading: Both needed premises hold on their cited, located passages (driftwood_pilot_2021 and regional_health_network_2022 independently); each premise's holding is reported on its own, not as a verdict on the claim as a whole.
fail_patterns: citing only one of the two sources for a premise that both sources support
omitting the section or page locator from a premise's evidence excerpt
downgrading a premise to UNSUPPORTED or CONTRADICTED despite two concordant, located sources
stating in Reading, rather than in a separate Cross-check line, that the claim as a whole is established
treating the Claim Decomposition table as replacing Section 4's existing two-source cross-check instead of sitting alongside it
ground_truth.expected_cross_check: driftwood_pilot_2021 and regional_health_network_2022 independently report the same readmission reduction and check-in protocol, satisfying the 2+-independent-source cross-check; the claim is established.

items.user_claim: Fact-check the following claims against the sources: (1) The Alderbrook youth fitness program increased VO2max among participants by 15% over one semester. (2) Participants attended sessions at least three times per week. (3) The program's instructors held national coaching certifications.

verified_source_set.summary: Alderbrook youth fitness program (2023), n = 48: mean VO2max rose 9% over one semester (not 15%). Session logs show a median of twice-weekly attendance. Instructor roster lists state, not national, coaching certifications.

ground_truth.expected_reading: The user asked to fact-check a list of claims, not to check the premises of one claim; fact-check mode output is unchanged (each of the three listed claims gets its own verdict such as Verified or False) and no Claim Decomposition block is produced for any of them, even though alderbrook2023 would contradict or leave several of them unsupported if decomposed.
fail_patterns: adding a Claim Decomposition block for any of the three listed claims
treating a fact-check request as a premise-check request because it names specific claims
decomposing claim (1), (2), or (3) into premises instead of giving it a fact-check verdict

items.user_claim: The Larkhaven Diabetes Prevention cohort reversed prediabetes in 40% of enrollees within six months, because participants followed a strict 1,200-calorie daily plan supervised by a registered dietitian.

verified_source_set.summary: Larkhaven Diabetes Prevention cohort (2020), n = 85: 22% of enrollees returned to normal glucose tolerance within six months. Dietary guidance was general calorie-reduction advice; no specific daily calorie target and no supervising dietitian is named.

expected_premise_verdicts.premise: 40% of enrollees reversed prediabetes within six months
expected_premise_verdicts.basis: larkhaven2020 reports the measured rate as 22%, not 40%

expected_premise_verdicts.premise: participants followed a strict 1,200-calorie daily plan supervised by a registered dietitian
expected_premise_verdicts.basis: larkhaven2020 names only general calorie-reduction advice, with no specific daily target and no dietitian

ground_truth.expected_reading: The first needed premise is contradicted by the source's own reported rate (22%, not 40%), so the claim fails as stated; report that contradiction first. The second needed premise (the specific calorie target and dietitian supervision) is separately unsupported, and is still listed after the contradiction, not dropped.
ground_truth.expected_cross_check: Only one source, larkhaven2020, is available, so the 2+-independent-source cross-check cannot run; the block states that fewer than two independent sources are available.
fail_patterns: reporting the UNSUPPORTED premise before the CONTRADICTED one
omitting the UNSUPPORTED premise once the CONTRADICTED one is reported
claiming the cross-check passed, or omitting the Cross-check line, when only one source is available
treating the single source as sufficient for the 2+-independent-source cross-check
